title: Nolan's Odyssey casting of Black actress as Helen of Troy ignites culture-war fight
description: Christopher Nolan's upcoming Homer adaptation drew fierce online attacks after Lupita Nyong'o was cast as Helen of Troy and Clytemnestra, with prominent commentators accusing the production of erasing European history. Defenders argued diverse casting treats the Western canon as shared civilizational heritage rather than racial gatekeeping. The dispute has turned a mythic epic into a flashpoint over identity, belonging, and who may claim classical stories in mass-market film.
